__comment__: KGPE-D16 (AST2050) host power-control GPIO config for op-pwrctl
Installed at /etc/default/obmc/gpio/gpio_defs.json in the fuller image.
op-pwrctl resolves each 'pin' (aspeed port) to a sysfs GPIO via the
1e780000.gpio chip base; power_up_outs drive the request lines, power_good_in
polls GPIOH2. See HW-WIRING-power-sensors.md and OPENBMC-POWER-INTEGRATION.md.
Why power_up_outs = [B1 pol LOW, F0 pol HIGH]: op-pwrctl drives each
power_up_out to (state XOR !polarity). For power ON (state=1): B1 -> 0
(POWERUP_N asserted) and F0 -> 1 (POWERDOWN_N de-asserted). For power OFF
(state=0): B1 -> 1 (de-asserted) and F0 -> 0 (POWERDOWN_N asserted). That maps
exactly onto the modeled set/reset power latch (aspeed_gpio_kgpe_d16_pwrseq):
B1-low sets host power, F0-low clears it. reset_outs pulses B6 (warm reset).
